# OORO

> OORO is a smart physical-media platform connecting brands with measurable digital displays in real-world environments, beginning with mobility.

## About

OORO helps brands plan, deliver and understand campaigns shown on connected displays across moving vehicles and other physical environments.

## Product

- Connected digital advertising displays
- Campaign and creative management
- Context-aware delivery where supported
- Proof of Play for delivered creative
- QR-based campaign engagement
- Advertiser campaign management and reporting

## Smart Screen

OORO passenger screens combine an advertising region, a live location utility panel, and a campaign-specific offer and QR panel. The offer and QR follow the creative currently playing. Routing and turn-by-turn directions are not currently part of the public product claim.

## Advertisers

Brands can choose a campaign package, provide campaign and creative details, deliver media to assigned screens, and review playback and QR engagement data where available.

## Measurement

OORO separates delivery measurement from engagement measurement. Playback events and Proof of Play describe creative delivery; QR scans describe passenger engagement.
